items.description: S0-VTOL with autonomous ship launch/landing capability, ~15,000 ft ceiling, 1+ km vertical sounding payload

notes: Early-stage NOAA Ron Brown vessel deployment concept for S0-VTOL with autonomous ship launch/recovery and atmospheric sounding mission. Spring 2028 target. Chidong Zhang actively evaluating lease vs. purchase options (detailed RFQ sent 2026-10-06). BST acknowledged production delays; current estimate mid-to-late 2027 availability. Collaboration includes publication requirements and training.
